_comment: Docs-sync marker for clawee.org. `surfaces` is the published UI/command surface: every place in the code whose text a user reads off this site. Each has a matching `DOCS-SYNC <anchor>` comment at that spot in the source — `grep -rn 'DOCS-SYNC' <repo>` is the authoritative list, and it should agree with this one. `syncs` records what each pass was verified against, so the next pass reviews `git log <sha>..origin/main` per repo instead of re-auditing. Never edit a past sync entry — prepend a new one.

surfaces.note: TOP-LEVEL page only. The FULL surface — every level, every flag — is the GENERATED cli:docs/cli-help.md (`clawee docs`, build-gated by TestDocsFileIsInSync); sync command tables from that file, never from this page alone.

surfaces.src: cli:cmd/clawee/help.go helpTree (relays node) — rendered in cli:docs/cli-help.md
surfaces.note: The full verb set (auto/gateway included). The hand-written relaysUsage string is GONE (2026-08-20 cli help port); `clawee relays --help` and the generated reference are the surface.
Per-tab: the Local and Remote hints differ (d = devices vs detach).
One bar per state: pair / re-check / continue.

Accepts MORE than the bar shows: +/- alias K/J, k/j alias arrows, q closes. The bar cannot grow (80-col budget), so the docs page is the only place these are published. 'G' (cycle gateway) was REMOVED here on 2026-07-29 — do not re-document it.
Acts on trust (approve/revoke a device key) — a silent drift here is worse than cosmetic.
Ctrl+U reveal / Ctrl+Backspace clear appear NOWHERE on screen. Docs are their only home.
No key bar is rendered at all — every key is invisible until pressed.

syncs.scope: gateway multi-user: tree picker (gateway + user rows), per-user devices view (pending-first, `devices · <gw> · <user>` title), devices approve by bare/index/fingerprint, and the pairing form's new no-user/user-refused states
syncs.notes: Synced against the DEV WORKTREES, not a released tag — the multi-user plan (docs/specs/2026-08-20-clawee-gateway-multi-user-design.md, resources repo) had not been cut at sync time, per the plan's own Task 13. Deliberately NOT against 'main' either: this documents what will ship once released. Updated #commands (devices/gateway top-level lines), #gateways (tree model: use <fp|name> [<user>], user <fp|name> add|rm <user>, GATEWAY list gains a USERS column, chooser keys r/u split — u now ADDS a user rather than overwriting one), #devices (per-(gateway,user) trust, pending-first queue, devices · <gw> · <user> title, approve [<#>|<fp>] semantics), and #pairing (new PairFormNoUser 'no user set' / 'user set — <user>' bar and PairFormUser 'user refused by the gateway — <user>' bar, plus the approve syntax). docs/index.html and llms-full.txt both updated (kept in lockstep per this repo's CLAUDE.md); the 'Docs synced' footer stamp is UNCHANGED — it names a released version, and none has shipped yet. Re-verify (and bump the stamp) once clawee/claweed actually release with this surface.

syncs.scope: stamp only — no page content changed
syncs.notes: Both components were re-cut to ship installer fixes, so the stamp had to move — but NOTHING on the page changed, and the review that justifies saying so is recorded here. cli is the SAME commit as the previous entry (04e3b4c): clawee v0.1.102's binary is byte-identical to v0.1.101 and only the inner installer inside the zip differs. The daemon delta d186508..c5ad76d touches install/install.sh.in and install_test.sh only — the installer's own output, which this site does not document (it documents the install one-liner, not what the installer prints). Version-parse fixes: release 8611a21 (clawee installer) + daemon #75 (claweed installer, both callers).

syncs.scope: release catch-up: stamp refresh + doctor version reporting
syncs.notes: clawee v0.1.101 + claweed v0.1.41 shipped, which CLOSES the divergence the previous entry recorded: the relay list's 'G' removal is now in released binaries, so the page describing q/Esc → chooser is true of what users run. Also documents what those releases added — `clawee doctor` now reports versions on every run including a dead chain (it used to print them only on the success path), and `claweed doctor` gained an installed-vs-running version row. Footer stamp moved v0.1.99/v0.1.39 → v0.1.101/v0.1.41 in both docs/index.html and llms-full.txt. A separate entry rather than an edit of the one below: that entry is an accurate record of what was verified at the time, divergence included.

syncs.scope: full alternate-view sweep: every picker/chooser/list/lock/pager view, its keys and description; DOCS-SYNC markers added in cli
syncs.notes: Second pass the same day, after the gateway/relay pass below. Added Views & keys index, Devices and Locking sections, the relay list's unadvertised keys (+/-, q/Esc), the Remote tab's differing row actions, and the /history pager keys. Every surface above now carries a DOCS-SYNC comment in cli (branch docs-sync-markers, off 1780887). Documenting the surface also RETIRED one key: the relay list's 'G' cycled gateway on a single unconfirmed keystroke — removed in the same branch (handler, hint, cycleGateway helper, tests), so the docs describe q/Esc → chooser instead. This sync therefore documents cli main + that branch, NOT released v0.1.99: until the branch ships, the released binary still answers G.

syncs.scope: gateway + relay surface, picker keys, in-picker device pairing
syncs.notes: Synced against the RELEASED surface, not cli main. cli 3835270 (#159 connection events) and 1780887 (#160 closed-session replay contract) were on main but unreleased at sync time and carry no doc-visible surface. daemon commits after 2a7cb15 (conn_log/audit) are internal.
Reconstructed from web commit 413e5b9. docs/index.html only — llms-full.txt was missed and still carried `gw` as canonical until the 2026-07-29 sync.
